kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستعطر (form X)
# أَسْتَعْطِرُ (ʔastaʕṭiru) /ʔas.taʕ.tˤi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْطَرَ (istaʕṭara)
# أَسْتَعْطِرَ (ʔastaʕṭira) /ʔas.taʕ.tˤi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْطَرَ (istaʕṭara)
# أَسْتَعْطِرْ (ʔastaʕṭir) /ʔas.taʕ.tˤir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَعْطَرَ (istaʕṭara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
